data.name: Fadhemaat
data.gender_notes: Fadhemaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is in charge of the house, the manager, the caretaker. The name Fadhemaat carries the meaning “Lady of the house” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fadhemaat usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of the house and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a woman who embodies the qualities of a strong, capable, and nurturing leader within her home and family
data.etymology: Fadhemaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lady of the house.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadhemaat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فَضِيمَات
in_arabic.meaning: النور الأبهى و المشتاق إلى الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: فَضِيمَات: نَسبَةٌ صُفّفِيَّةٌ مِنَ القُرُشِ، وَفي الَّتي تَعني النُور اَلأَبْهى وَمَشتاقٍ إلَى اللَهِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ أَسماكِ العُيونِ الَّتي يُدعى بِهَا مَن يَطلُبُ النورَ وَيَستَمدُهُ مِنَ اللَهِ وَيَبقى عَلى ضِياءِ العَلمِ وَالإِخلاصِ، وَيَستَمدُ مِنَ اللَهِ الَّذي يَنيرُ وَيَشرَقُ دَهرَ العالَمينَ، وَهِيَ تَسمّى بِأَسماءِ النورِ وَالإِضاحَةِ وَالتَنويمِ، وَهِيَ مَشتاقَةٌ إلَى العَلَمينِ وَالعَلياءِ، وَهِيَ صَديقةُ العَلياءِ وَالجودِ، وَهِيَ عَضوٌ مِنَ الجَمعِ وَالعَدَدِ، وَهِيَ مَشتاقَةٌ إلَى الرَحمنِ وَالرَحيمِ، وَهِيَ مِنَ مَشتاقاتِ المُؤمِنينَ وَالسّائِلينَ

in_urdu.long_meaning: فضیمات: سفیہ سے تعلق رکھنے والی ایک tribe کا نام ہے اور اس کے معنی بھی اہم ہیں۔ یہ نام اس کے علاوہ نور کا بھی ہے جو کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام ہے جس کا ذکر قرآن میں کئی مقامات پر ہوا ہے۔ اسی طرح یہ نام مشتاق کا بھی ہے۔ مشتاق کا مطلب ہے جو اللہ کے ساتھ پیار کرتا ہے اور اللہ تعالیٰ سے محبت کا جذبہ رکھتا ہے۔ ایک عالم یا مومن جس میں اللہ کے لیے محبت اور عشق ہو وہ کو مشتاق کہا جاتا ہے۔ اس نام کے لیے بھی اسی طرح کے جذبات ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: फ़ढ़ीमात
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का सर्वश्रेष्ठ नूर और अल्लाह के प्रेमी
in_hindi.long_meaning: फ़ढ़ीमात: यह एक अरबी शब्द है जिसका प्रयोग अक्सर अरबी और फ़ारसी भाषाओं में किया जाता है। इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह का सर्वश्रेष्ठ नूर और अल्लाह के प्रेमी। इस शब्द का महत्व और प्रसिद्धी इस्लामी सभ्यता और संस्कृति में काफ़ी है। यह शब्द अक्सर मुस्लिम परिवारों में बच्चियों के नाम के रूप में चुना जाता है।

in_english.name: Fadhemaat
in_english.meaning: The most beautiful light and the one who is devoted to Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Fadhemaat: This name is derived from the Arabic root ف-ض-م, which means 'to be devoted' or 'to be committed'. In Islamic tradition, the name Fadhemaat refers to the most beautiful light, which is a reference to Allah's attribute of being the source of all light and guidance. The name also connotes the idea of being devoted to Allah, which is a key aspect of the Islamic faith. In Islamic tradition, the name Fadhemaat is associated with the virtues of being kind, gentle, and compassionate. It is also said to be a name that inspires devotion and loyalty to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fadhemaat, derived from the Arabic term "Fa-dha-mah-at," signifies a woman who takes care of the household and its members. In Islamic culture, a strong emphasis is placed on the role and responsibilities of women within the home, which includes nurturing and raising children, managing household finances, and maintaining the family's social and moral standards. By bestowing a daughter with this name, parents express their hope that she will grow up to be a capable and devoted homemaker, assuming her role within the family with grace and diligence.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its literal meaning, the name Fadhemaat holds significant spiritual resonance within the Islamic tradition. It is understood as a reminder of the sacred duty of every Muslim to serve and protect the sanctity of their homes, emulating the Prophet Muhammad's description of the home as a source of peace and refuge. The name also underscores the value of family and its role in the larger community. In spiritually nurturing her family, a Fadhemaat, in turn, fosters a harmonious and loving community that reflects the values and teachings of Islam.
